querystring.select: SELECT MEMBER.OFFICE_CODE AS OfficeCode, MEMBER.OFFICE_NAME AS OfficeName, MEMBER.MR_OFFICE_TYPE_CODE AS MrOfficeTypeCode, MEMBER.REF_OFFICE_ID AS RefOfficeId, MEMBER.IS_ACTIVE AS IsActive
querystring.from: FROM dbo.REF_OFFICE RO WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CGOM.REF_OFFICE_ID FROM dbo.CENTER_GRP CG WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.REF_OFFICE RO WITH(NOLOCK) ON CG.CENTER_GRP_CODE = RO.OFFICE_CODE AND RO.REF_OFFICE_ID = 1 JOIN dbo.CENTER_GRP_OFFICE_MBR CGOM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CGOM.CENTER_GRP_ID = CG.CENTER_GRP_ID ) AS MEMBER ON RO.REF_OFFICE_ID = MEMBER.REF_OFFICE_ID
